newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's NLCF passes on 40,000T soymeal tender.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's NLCF passes on 40,000T soymeal tender.

text.p: South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation (NLCF) said on Tuesday it passed on a tender to buy 40,000 tonnes of soymeal due to higher-than-expected prices.
An official at the federation said it had invited tenders for arrival by September 30 or October 20 to the ports of Inchon, Kunsan and Ulsan.
Traders said the lowest offer was made by Cargill at $272.34 a tonne C&F for both arrivals.
Shipment for arrival by September 30 was set for August 25-September 13, if sourced from India or July 28-August 16, if from South America.
Shipment for arrival by October 20 was set for September 14-October 3, if from India, or August 17-September 5, if from South America. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5651
